ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 1.85 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.4625, 2026-06-30: 0.4625) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.4625, 2025-06-30: 0.4625) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2010-03-31..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-06-30..2009-12-31, 6 facts); paid FY facts for 16 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2016-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31); both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

notes: dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2010-03-31..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-06-30..2009-12-31, 6 facts); paid FY facts for 16 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2016-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.85 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.4625, 2026-06-30: 0.4625) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.4625, 2025-06-30: 0.4625) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)

frequency: the FY2025 total is a paid fact and the quarterly facts inside that year are declared facts — the payment count needs both from one tag, so the cadence is read from the spacing of the quarterly facts
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
